newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee ends week steady at 35.84/85 per dlr.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee ends week steady at 35.84/85 per dlr.

text.p: The Indian rupee ended Friday at 35.8475/8550 against the dollar compared to the opening level of 35.85/86, dealers said.
The dollar has been moving in a narrow groove of 35.84/86 level for most of the weak, dealers said.
Poor demand and the virtual abstention of leading state-run bank had the dollar stuck at this level, dealers said.
"There was some dollar selling towards the close," said a dealer at a private bank, explaining the rupee's mild revival.
The forward dollar premia continued to ease on the back of receiving interest from banks and corporates and easing liquidity conditions in the money market, dealers said.
The six-month annualised forward premium ended at 7.31 percent compared with the previous close of 7.42 percent.
